defs.def: a large grave, especially one built of stone above or below the ground 坟墓；冢

ex.s: The house seemed quiet as a tomb without the boy living there.
ex.t: 没有男孩住在那里，房子安静得像座坟墓。

ex.s: Your friend, Richard Come and see the Terracotta Army: more than 8,000 statues were made in the third century BCE to guard the tomb of the Chinese Emperor Qinshihuang!
ex.t: 你的朋友理查德来看Terracotta军团：在3世纪BCE制造了8000多尊雕像，以守卫中国皇帝秦庄公墓!.

ex.s: The statues fill only one part of the emperor’s huge tomb, which still has not been completely unearthed.
ex.t: 雕像仅填补了皇帝庞大墓穴的一部分，至今尚未完全发掘。

ex.s: More than 700,000 people worked for nearly 40 years to build this tomb.
ex.t: 70多万人在将近40年的时间里为建造这座坟墓而工作。

ex.s: However, no one in modern times knew about the tomb or the terracotta statues until 1974, when some farmers discovered the tomb while they were digging a well!
ex.t: 然而，直到 1974 年，现代人才知道这座陵墓和兵马俑的存在，当时一些农民在挖井时发现了这座陵墓！

ex.s: The relics were found in the tomb of Haihunhou, where experts have been digging since 2011.
ex.t: 文物发现于海洪侯墓,2011年起专家在此进行发掘。
